americanSamoaRecipes.title: Authentic American Samoan Cuisine
americanSamoaRecipes.description: Traditional recipes from American Samoa featuring Pacific island flavors, coconut, taro, and seafood

breakfast.name: Oka
instructions: Mix diced fish with lime juice and salt
Serve with crackers or taro chips
breakfast.notes: Raw fish 'cooked' in coconut milk and citrus, Pacific island delicacy

breakfast.name: Taro Pancakes
instructions: Mix grated taro with flour, eggs, sugar, baking powder, salt
Fry until golden on both sides
Serve hot with honey or syrup
breakfast.notes: Starchy root vegetable pancakes, traditional breakfast
